scope: Headline scope (Products A + B, all 5 countries, S$-weighted), the same pre-registered backtest as backtest.json. Rows change only the series the model is trained on: raw SAP records (recorded country × recorded product) or golden IDs (true country × true product). Both rows are scored against the same de-duplicated actuals, i.e. what each country really ordered. Raw differs from golden where misattribution (SG-coded duplicates of MY/VN hospitals from Jan 2026) and miscategorisation (reagent kits coded as Product B) shift the series.
sentence: On raw records our method is worse than today's (15 vs 13 per 100 ordered): it faithfully learns the fake level shifts; in SG Product A it tends to over-forecast by 22.8% because the SG-coded duplicates of MY/VN hospitals add a fake jump from Jan 2026. A better model on dirty data makes things worse. Cleaning master data alone cuts today's error by 1.7 points per 100 ordered; on clean data ours cuts a further 2.8, 4.5 points in all. Clean the data first, then model.
